name: Rudin's conjecture on squares in arithmetic progressions
informal:
A stronger form of Rudin's conjecture: for every $N \ge 6$, the arithmetic progression
$24 n + 1$ attains the maximum $Q(N)$.
informal_en:
A stronger form of Rudin's conjecture: for every $N \ge 6$, the arithmetic progression
$24 n + 1$ attains the maximum $Q(N)$.
